subject: Recipe card: two-profile decision
body:
Team,

Decisions from Friday's review, ahead of window close on 6/8:

1. Recipe card ships with two profiles, per Carmen's finding: "small-data compositional" (relative positions, copy decoder, weight sharing) and "large-data semantic parsing" (relative positions, copy decoder, no sharing). One-default was the goal, but the COGS/CFQ split is real and the card should say so.
2. Card v1 publishes to platform docs 6/5, marked provisional pending error bars.
3. The July repetition matrix is confirmed as the follow-through: Wei runs the full num_repetitions grid and we stamp v1.1 "evidence-final" by end of July. PCFG gets double repetitions given the variance Carmen flagged.

Thanks all — this is the kind of boring-but-load-bearing work the platform exists for.

Dmitri
